description:
🔋 Long-Lasting Removable Battery
Ride farther with a high-capacity 48V 23Ah (960Wh) lithium-ion battery. Enjoy up to 100 miles on Pedal Assist mode, and conveniently recharge in just 6–7 hours with the removable design.

⚡ Powerful Dual Motor Performance
Equipped with two independent 1500W brushless motors, this beast delivers a combined peak output of 3000W. The all-wheel drive system gives you the power to conquer steep 35° hills and hit thrilling speeds of up to 40 MPH with ease.

🏔️ All-Terrain Fat Tires
Take on any surface with confidence. The 26" x 4.0" puncture-resistant, anti-slip fat tires provide exceptional grip and stability on snow, sand, mud, gravel, or city streets.

🛡️ Comfort & Safety Upgraded
Designed for a smooth and secure ride, featuring a front suspension fork to absorb shocks, responsive mechanical disc brakes for reliable stopping power, plus a super-bright headlight with a built-in horn for added visibility and safety.

📊 Smart LED Display & Extras
Stay in control with a high-definition color LED display showing speed, battery level, distance, and PAS mode at a glance. Comes with a free phone mount, perfect for navigation on the go.

💪 Built Tough, High Capacity
Crafted from premium 6061 aluminum alloy, this durable frame weighs just 65.2 lbs while supporting an impressive payload of up to 396 lbs—built to handle both rider and cargo with ease.
